name: adult white dragon

special_abilities.name: ice walk
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra moment.

special_abilities.name: legendary resistance
special_abilities.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 ft. of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: cold breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 54 (12d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: detect
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: tail attack
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: wing attack (costs 2 actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

lore:
The Adult White Dragon, or the "Glacial Scourge," haunts the most desolate, frost-bitten peaks and subterranean ice-flows. While other drakes possess a cruel, calculating intellect, the White is a primal manifestation of the blizzard itself. They are peerless ambushers, burying themselves beneath deep snowdrifts for weeks, their pale, jagged scales indistinguishable from the permafrost until a victim’s warmth betrays them.

Their predatory instinct is singular: they do not bargain; they consume. Local folklore depicts them as the "Breath of the North Wind," vengeful spirits born from the hearts of dying glaciers. To the nomadic mountain tribes, a sighting is a dire omen of the "Year of the Shroud"—a winter that refuses to yield to spring. These dragons find a morbid comfort in the silence of absolute zero, often preserving their prey as crystalline statues, grim monuments to their territorial hunger. To the unwary traveler, the warning is simple: in the blinding white-out, the dragon is not merely within the storm; the dragon *is* the storm.
